# olh'o'posto

> Community photos of EV charging stations and sockets in Portugal, with one stable static photo link per station and per socket, keyed by the official NAP Portugal (MOBI.E) codes.

Pages are in European Portuguese, with English under /en/. Station and socket data come from NAP Portugal (MOBI.E), matched to OpenStreetMap, and are refreshed daily. Photo uploads are not open yet, so most static links still return 404.

## Pages

- [Station page](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/stations/EZC-AMD-00051): `/en/stations/{station id}` in English, `/postos/{station id}` in Portuguese.
- [Search](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/search?q=amadora): `/en/search?q=` (or `/pesquisa?q=`). A full station or socket code goes straight to its page.
- Socket lookup: `/en/sockets/{EVSE code}` (or `/tomadas/{EVSE code}`) redirects to the station page, anchored on that socket. The code works with or without the `*` (`PT*EZC*E*AMD*00051*1` or `PTEZCEAMD000511`).

## API

Read-only JSON, open CORS, no key.

- `GET /api/v1/stations/{station id}`: the station, its operator, address, coordinates, OSM element and sockets. Each socket has its EVSE code as published (`evse`) and without the `*` (`compact`), which is the name of its static link. The station and each socket carry `photo` (or `null`): credit, licence, a ready-to-paste `attribution`, the three sizes (`thumb`, `main`, `full`, each with `url` and `maxPx`, the longest side), the station page and the Panoramax viewer link.
- `GET /api/v1/stations?q={words}&limit={1-50}`: full-text search over station code, name, address, town and operator. Every word must match, as a prefix, accents ignored. Public stations only, best match first.
- `GET /api/v1/stations?lat={deg}&lon={deg}&radius={metres, default 500, max 5000}&limit={1-50}`: public stations near a point, nearest first, each with `distance_m`. Use either `q` or `lat`/`lon`, not both.
- `GET /api/v1/main-photos`: every published main photo (station or socket) with its credit, the three sizes on pictures.ocarroeletrico.com, the station page and the Panoramax picture id. Licence CC BY-SA 4.0: credit the author.
- `GET /api/v1/evses/{EVSE code}`: the socket and its station, each with `photo` (or `null`) as above. 300 with `candidates` when the NAP lists the same code at more than one station, 404 when unknown.
- `GET /api/v1/ranking?period=month|all`: top contributors by points (month = current month, UTC).

## Static photo links

- `https://pictures.ocarroeletrico.com/{station id}.jpg` (1024 px), `.thumb.jpg` (400 px), `.full.jpg` (2048 px).
- Sockets use the EVSE code without the `*`: `https://pictures.ocarroeletrico.com/PTEZCEAMD000511.jpg`.
- The link never changes; the photo behind it can. 404 until the station or socket has a main photo.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Privacy policy](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/privacy) (pt-PT: /privacidade)
- [Terms of use](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/terms) (pt-PT: /termos): what uploaders and API token holders agree to
- [Ask for a photo to be removed](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/report) (pt-PT: /report): no account; the photo is hidden at once and a moderator decides within 72 hours. Each API `photo` has a prefilled `report` link.
